tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ gsang bdag dregs pa 'dul byed las tshogs dam sri'i glud mdos zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ thugs gsang 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs pre ta bod yul du: dam sri 'byung po kha dar na: de nyid 'dul ba'i gdams pa bstan: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: bod 'dir dam sri 'byung po dang: gson 'dre dngos su rgyug pa 'byung: nyin mo dur khrod kun tu rgyug: mtshan mo 'gro ba'i srog dbugs rgol: gzugs ni sngags btsun bud med gzugs: skad ni byol song gcan gzan skad: de yi nad gdon zhugs pa'i rtags: ngos gzung med pa'i gnyan nad dang: glo bur smyo 'bog brgyal nad 'ong: kha cig drang srong gza' nad 'dra: kha cig ji mi snyam gyis 'chi: kha cig kha lkug lus 'dar zhing: rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur: de rnams srung zlog gsad pa'i thabs: mang bar 'dug kyang 'dir ma smros: de rnams glud kyis bkar thabs bstan: snod shin tu che ba'i nang du dam sri btsun gzugs lag na rkang gling thogs pa: g.yas su sngags pa nag po bswe zhwa can thun phor thogs pa: g.yon du bud med nag mo rang gi skra nas bzung ba: de rnams snying gar triḥdzaḥdu: yig 'bru bris la snying gar bcug: 'bru nag la bca': mtha' skor du yul mi rnams kyi changs bu: phyugs shi tshad kyi spu dang ra rmig rnams ji ltar tshogs pas bskor: sha dum tshwa ram pa sgog pa sogs yas stags tshang bar bsags: yi dam gtor zlog sngon du song nas byin rlabs bskyed chog ni: oṃ swa bhā ba sogs/ rang nyid lhar gsal mdun du ni: rgyal bsen btsun gzugs rkang gling thogs: dam sri sngags chas thun phor can: bsen mo nag mo rang skra 'dzin: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dre mo sogs: rang rang 'khor tshogs du mas bskor: nad bdag yams bdag glud kyi bdag: dpag med khrom tshogs bzhin du gsal: rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas: 'od zer khro tshogs rab khros nas:

gdon bgegs dam sri pho mo kun: mdun gyi gzugs la thim par gyur: na mo: sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang: chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams kyi bka'= lha sngags ting 'dzin bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang: bden pa chen po'i mthus bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i rgyal bsen dam sri bsen mo: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga: nad bdag yams bdag gnod cing 'tshe ba thams cad glud kyi gtor ma len pa'i ched du 'dir khug cig: lan gsum brjod: yi dam gang yin sngags sham du lan bdun brjod: oṃ ga du dha ra dha ka rak+sha ra: tri sa ya: tri sa ya: dzi li thar phroṃ rbad: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trig nan hur thums dza: mā ra ya rbad: gnod byed gson 'dre pho mo ang ku sha dza: zhes gzugs la bstim: glud chas byin brlab pa ni: stong pa'i ngang las rin chen snod yangs par: khaṃ yig las byung glud gtor rgya che ba: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang rab ldan te: so sor mos pa'i ro mchog char 'beb gyur: bde gshegs rin chen mang dang gzugs mdzes dang: 'byams klas 'jigs kun bral la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ āḥhūm̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: zhes brjod la gong gi byin rlabs tshar nas sngags tshar gsum mam bdun skabs dang bstun: rab la brgya rtsa brgyad: 'bring la lnga bcu lo grangs nyer dgu bdun sogs grangs bsags la: kyai: dam nyams khrel med dam la 'dus: gson 'dre pho mo dam la 'dus: nad bdag yams bdag dam la 'dus: sngon yang dam tshig nyams pas na: las ngan 'dre yi lus su skyes: 'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni: lus ngan gnas nas thar dus med: dam ldan sngags 'chang dam la 'dus: gzhan la gnod pa'i sems spangs na: mtho ris bde ba thob pa yin: de phyir glud gtor changs bu dang: 'dod pa'i yas stags tshang ba 'di:

longs la yul 'di'i mi phyugs la: ma gnod mtha' yi rgya mtsho la: thug gi bar du 'gro bar gyis: 'on kyang phyi mig ma blta zhig: tshar grangs bsags nas de nas kha bsgyur la: gal te bka' las 'da' byed na: khyod kyi srog snying nga la yod: gnad du bor nas brlag ta re: khyod kyi ngan mtshang nga la yod: ngan mtshang smras na mi gnod dam: de bas yul 'di'i mi phyugs la: bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrol: nad kha chod la yams kha sgyur: gnas mal spos la myur du song: mtha' med rgya mtsho'i pha rol song: khyod kyi gnas kyang de na mchis: 'dod pa'i yon tan de na ldan: glud dang yas stags 'di khyer la: myur ba nyid du de ru song: dam nyams khrel med de ru song: gson 'dre pho mo de ru song: nad bdag yams bdag de ru song: 'on kyang phyi mig ma blta zhig: ces pa khro bo gang rung sngags sham la gzir sngags btags la thun gyis brabs la yas stags chu la dor: oṃ ga du dha ra dha ka rak+sha sa tri ya: sa tri ya: tri sa ya: tri sa ya: dzi li thar phrom rbad: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trig nan: hur thums dza mā ra ya rbad rbad: gnod byed gson 'dre pho mo mā ra ya rbad rbad: hab le hob le dza: gnod byed pho mo'i gti mug sha la myag myag: 'dod chags khrag la ljib ljib: zhe sdang rus la rbad rbad: spu gri 'bar bas shad shad snying la shad: raṃ raṃ srog la raṃ: srog rtsa dmar po tri du dza: mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces khro bo bskul: srung 'khor bsgom: gu gul bsreg: thun gtor: de ltar byas na nad yams chad par the tshom med do: kho bo rol pa'i rdo rje ngas// gnas mchog rdo rje cong phug gi /sra mkhregs brag gi 'dom gang sar// ro sol nang na gter sgrom 'dug /kun gyis mthong bar spyan drangs nas// shog dril dang po'i zhal las bshus// mkhas grub rnams kyis gzigs mdzod dang*// kun la phan pa'i gdams ngag zab// sa mā ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ ྈྈྈྈྈྈ sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/
